newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends lower, fails at key level.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends lower, fails at key level.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed a thinly-traded session weaker, with prices remaining in their recent trading range between 10.35 and 10.50 cents basis the March contract.
Dealers said producer scale-up selling continued to limit gains, but light buying by the trade kept prices from sinking below support seen around 10.35 in March.
The spot month finished 0.03 lower to 10.42 cents, having traded from 10.47 to 10.36 cents. The back months ended 0.03 lower to 0.06 higher.

Technically, the market appears weak after failing several times to maintain gains above the key 10.47 to 10.50 area, dealers said. However, steady trade buying in the May contract kept the market stable at the lows.
While dealers noted talk of inquiries they said there are few concrete and substantial deals to inspire the market.
